I advised the commander on the training plan for a special operations company.
I maintained network switches for a battalion and tracked every repair ticket until it closed.
I monitored network alerts and wrote incident summaries for the shift lead.
I repaired missile system electronics and recorded test results for each unit.
I drove and maintained a tracked vehicle and trained new crew members on checks.
I ran the food inspection program for a large installation.
I planned the schedule and coverage for a small team of specialists.
I led a company of about one hundred soldiers through a training year.
I coordinated with partner groups to plan community engagement for my unit.
I scheduled vehicle movements for a supply route and tracked each delivery.
I briefed commanders on source reports and checked each report for accuracy.
I monitored satellite data feeds and wrote hourly status notes.
I prepared purchase request packages and checked them against the contract rules.
